title: Invoicing & Payments delete-column label reads "Delete / Reverse" in the role editor
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Invoicing and Payments Permissions
expected: Invoicing & payments Delete column header reads "Delete / Reverse"
actual: In role editor, Invoicing & payments card headers read View, Create & Edit, Delete / Reverse; other cards use plain Delete

title: Enabling Invoicing and Payments Delete while Manage AP/AR is OFF prompts to enable AP/AR
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Invoicing and Payments Permissions
expected: Enabling Invoicing Delete while Manage AP/AR OFF opens an AP/AR modal
actual: On Create Role page with See Financial Data ON and "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch OFF, clicking the Invoicing & payments Delete checkbox (directly, and after View+Create&Edit) enabled Delete with NO AP/AR modal appearing
reason: No AP/AR prompt fires; Delete enables directly, contradicting expected

title: Invoicing and Payments View grants Finance tab on WO and invoice visibility from WO/part sales
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Invoicing and Payments Permissions
expected: Finance tab visible on WO; invoices accessible; no create/edit/reverse affordances
actual: WO detail shows Finance tab; Finance view is read-only with only export/email/print actions - no create/edit/reverse/void/deposit/send-to-terminal buttons
reason: Finance tab visible and read-only as expected

title: Invoicing and Payments View OFF with See Financial ON: pricing visible but no invoice access
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Invoicing and Payments Permissions
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST Tech (workOrdersView, partSalesView, customersView, seeFinancialData ON; NO invoicing perms)
expected: Pricing visible on WO; Finance tab hidden; invoices unreachable
actual: WO shows pricing ($232.43/$256.84/$269.68); Finance tab absent (tabs Lines/Parts/Notes/Stats)
reason: SFD ON shows pricing; no invoicing perm hides Finance tab

title: Collecting Deposits on a work order requires Invoicing and Payments: Create and Edit
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Invoicing and Payments Permissions
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST Tech (invoicingPaymentsView+CreateEdit, SFD ON) vs view-only
expected: Deposit action NOT visible for View-only user; visible for Create&Edit user
actual: WO Finance tab shows Add Deposit action with Inv Create&Edit; view-only invoicing role had no deposit action (only export/email/print)
reason: Deposit action gated by Invoicing Create&Edit as expected

title: Invoicing and Payments Delete enables delete payments and void transactions (NOT reverse invoices)
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Invoicing and Payments Permissions
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST Tech (invoicing V/E/D, partSales V/E/D, customers V/E, SFD+AP/AR ON)
actual: Customer Payments tab shows per-payment delete-icon buttons (aria Delete); absent when Invoicing Delete OFF; no Reverse exposed on WO finance
reason: Per-payment delete present, gated by Invoicing Delete

title: Customer payment delete requires Invoicing and Payments Delete, NOT Customer Management Delete
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Invoicing and Payments Permissions
role_used: User A: cust V/E/D + inv V/E (no inv delete); User B: cust V/E + inv V/E/D
expected: A blocked (no delete); B can delete despite lacking Customer Delete
actual: A: no payment delete affordance; B: per-payment delete buttons present
reason: Payment delete gated by Invoicing Delete, not Customer Delete

title: See Financial Data OFF makes Invoicing and Payments inaccessible even with View+Edit+Delete
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Invoicing and Payments Permissions
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST Tech (invoicing V/E/D, SFD OFF via API bypass, AP/AR ON, workOrdersView)
expected: Finance tab not present; no invoicing affordances; inaccessible due to SFD OFF
actual: WO tabs Lines/Parts/Notes/Stats, no Finance tab, no pricing; invoicing inaccessible despite V/E/D perms
reason: SFD gate beats CRUD as expected

title: Invoicing and Payments Create and Edit enables invoice creation and payment processing
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Invoicing and Payments Permissions
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST Tech (invoicing V/E, SFD ON, workOrdersView)
expected: Create invoice, process payment, modify invoice all succeed
actual: Create Invoice affordance present on WO Finance tab (gated by Inv Create&Edit), but clicking it produced no invoice - test WO (estimate) does not meet invoice prerequisites (parts received + review completed per domain note); could not complete the create/payment/modify flow end-to-end
reason: Affordance present but full functional invoice-creation flow not executable on available data - needs manual verify

title: Send to Terminal action requires Invoicing and Payments: Create and Edit
section_path: Custom Roles - (Revised) > Invoicing and Payments Permissions
role_used: ZZAUTOTEST Tech (invoicing V/E vs V only, SFD ON)
expected: Send to Terminal hidden for View-only; visible for Create&Edit; initiates terminal flow
actual: WO Finance for view-only had only export/email/print (no Send to Terminal); for Create&Edit showed Create Invoice + Add Deposit but NOT Send to Terminal because the test WO is an estimate with no unpaid invoice - Send to Terminal appears on an unpaid invoice which could not be created
reason: Requires an existing unpaid invoice to surface Send to Terminal; could not create one - needs manual verify
